overall: The AG found the Board violated the OML by posting minute-approval notices without the minutes' dates and by inaccurate Feb 9 minutes; it found no violation on the other procedural complaint claims and ordered amended minutes and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Notices for the Feb 9 and March 2 meetings listed only 'Approval of Meeting Minutes' without the dates of the minutes to be approved.
allegations.key_passage: The Board acknowledges that the dates of the meeting minutes that were to be approved were reasonably anticipated by the chair, thus we find that the Board

allegations.summary: The Board discussed a complaint filed the same day (Feb 9) that was not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Where the complaint was filed on February 9, the day of the meeting, the topic could not have been anticipated by the Chair 48 hours before the meeting.

allegations.summary: The Feb 9 minutes did not reflect the Board's discussion of the Open Meeting Law complaint filed that day.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the minutes of the February 9 meeting are inaccurate where they do not mention or describe the discussion of the complaint filed on February 9.

allegations.summary: The Board allegedly did not meet to review the Feb 9 complaint before the chair was delegated to respond within 14 days.
allegations.key_passage: Though we accept that the Board discussed the Open Meeting Law complaint before responding

allegations.summary: The Board allegedly did not mail or email the Feb 17 response to the complainant.
allegations.key_passage: we credit the Board’s statement that it mailed a response on February 17, which was 6 business days after the complaint was received.

allegations.summary: The Feb 17 response allegedly did not address the allegations raised in the Feb 9 complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Since the Board responded, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Amend the minutes of the February 9 meeting to accurately reflect the discussion of the Open Meeting Law complaint and certify to the AG within thirty (30) days.
Amend the minutes of the March 2 meeting if the Board discussed the complaint during that meeting as well.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: we order the Board to amend the minutes of the February 9 meeting to accurately reflect the discussion that occurred on this topic and to certify to this office within thirty (30) days of the date of this letter that it has done so.
